entries.zh: 使水冷却（如淬铁之水）；冷水
entries.en: to chill water (as iron is quenched); cold water
entries.notes: L 栏 "venel" 疑为 "el" 之讹，M 栏音写夹杂西语，释义依 H「冷水」与 R「lèng chùi」互证。

entries.en: to deceive; to cheat; to swindle
entries.notes: H 栏字形「騗」为「騙」之异体，辨识存疑，故降为 medium。

entries.en: to conceal; to hoodwink; to deceive by hiding the truth
to lie to; to delude with false words
entries.notes: R 栏 "faòng" 与「誑」音不合，疑为对音讹写；释义依 H/M 栏。

entries.zh: 以纠葛缠绕之事相欺；设局蒙骗
entries.en: to deceive by entanglement; to ensnare with complications
entries.notes: H 栏「需」于「以纠葛相欺」义无所取，疑为形近讹字；释义仅依 L 栏。

entries.en: to cheat and make off with another's goods
entries.notes: L 栏 "alcarse conlo ageno" 即 "alzarse con lo ajeno"；H 栏「末」与音写 mōa/boā 不合，字有讹误。

entries.zh: 背信；违背诺言而以谎言相欺
entries.en: to go back on one's word; to be false to; to lie
entries.notes: 「背」与 mentir 的对应须由「背信、背约」义推得，非字面直训。

entries.en: to conceal the truth; to act deceitfully in bad conscience
to bewilder; to confuse; to infatuate
to cajole with fair words; to incite and deceive
entries.notes: H「煽」与 M "siēn" 相合，R 栏 "piēn" 疑与前行「騙」条混。

entries.en: to lure away; to abduct (children or pregnant women)
to delude; to confuse
entries.notes: L 栏 "el ano engañando" 语义不明，疑为 "el uno" 之讹，释义依 H/M 栏。

entries.zh: 诈（恃强凌弱、以大欺小地行骗）；欺诈
entries.en: to defraud; to cheat (the elder deceiving the younger)
entries.notes: R 栏 "kùàng" 与「詐」音不合，疑为「誆」之对音；释义依 H/M 与 L 栏。

entries.zh: 借坏女人设局行骗；因女色而受骗
entries.en: to deceive by means of a wicked woman
entries.notes: H 栏「拆」与 L 义不合，R "chūe" 亦与「拆」音不合，释义依 L 栏。

entries.en: crafty; cunning; a cheat
entries.notes: H/M 相合（狡，cau），R 栏 "guian" 音不合，疑为「奸」之对音。

entries.zh: 冒认；冒名顶替、假冒他人
entries.en: to falsely claim as one's own; to impersonate
entries.notes: H 栏「冐認」即「冒認」；L 栏 "urel idioma" 残缺讹误，释义依 H/R 栏。

entries.zh: 瞒过活人眼目（当众遮掩真相）
entries.en: to hoodwink the living; to hide the truth from people's eyes
entries.notes: L 栏 "los parientes y cuidan de el muerto" 残讹且与 H 不合，R 栏 "moân kâng xîn mō" 亦错位；释义依 H/M 栏。

entries.zh: 瞒人眼目；以手法蒙混欺骗
entries.en: to hoodwink people; to deceive by trickery
to conceal and obscure; to hoodwink
to swindle; to cheat
to abduct; to kidnap by coaxing
